column1: # The cities with a prayer-times page on taqwa.world. One city per line, tab-separated:
# id         the city's GeoNames id in the app's shared/src/commonMain/composeResources/files/cities.csv;
#            the country, coordinates and time zone always come from there, never from here.
# languages  the page languages, space-separated; English is always one of them.
# featured   the languages whose home page lists the city.
# names      lang=Name pairs separated by ';', only where the app's own name is wrong or reads
#            badly as a page title. Every one here is a finding to fix in the app's city files.
# Nothing about the calculation is set here. A page shows exactly what the app shows a user in
# that city who has changed no setting: the timetable or method the engine resolves for the city,
# its Asr school, the automatic high-latitude rule, no adjustments.
# A row is un-held when the stamps prove every day its page shows (rulings R101, R115 and R116,
# spec §2 in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-29-city-pages-design.md): the engine resolves the city
# to a class A, B or C entry, measured at the city, with a green stamp for the entry and its unit,
# and every day of this month checked for every timetable the page depends on (ruling R117: a cautious
# member's day its table does not publish or gets wrong, recorded in the gate file, does not block while
# another member's table is checked that day); next month is shown
# too once every day of it is checked. tools/timetables applies the rule on every build and holds a
# row it rejects, with a notice, so a city whose timetable is not yet checked for this month holds
# by itself (London Unified's ends 31 December 2026: gate the 2027 table before January) and comes
# back at the first build after its month is checked (Diyanet's captures reach 1 November 2026:
# İstanbul and Ankara show October alone until a capture completes November). A held row comes back
# by deleting its "# " once its stamp qualifies; a row the rule rejects is never published. The
# proof is in tools/timetables/official/stamps and summarised at /prayer-times/how-taqwa-checks/.
# tools/timetables validates every row on every build: an unknown id, a duplicate slug, a page
# language with no name, or a featured language without a page fails the build.
# Saudi Arabia: Umm al-Qura (sa.ummalqura, class A).

# Egypt: ESA (eg.esa, class B) at Cairo, Alexandria, Giza (Cairo's unit), Port Said, Suez, Luxor and Aswan, each its town's unit. Its stamp now covers October 2026 (the monitor's captures of 28 Sep and 2 Oct), so the pages show October alone until November is checked.
